spec.kitLine: Activates at start + when Full Burst ends
spec.assertion: Formation branch is a STATIC squad fact, so the re-evaluation at FB-end is a no-op; encoded as formation gates 'noB1'/'hasB1'. Fails under a single ungated block (which would pay both branches in every comp).

spec.kitLine: Combat Assist: Changes to Burst Stage 1
spec.assertion: No effect kind re-tiers a unit's burst stage; the formation gate is the only expressible carrier. Asserted structurally (both gates present); the stage change itself is untestable in a hasB1 fixture.

buffApply atkPct=95.04 count === fullBurstStart count and every targetSlug is rapi-red-hood. Fails under burstCast keying (wrong count / wrong phase) and under target:'allies' (teammate slugs appear, and zeroing it would move teammate totals — separately asserted byte-identical).
Zero attackDamagePct=8.02 applies in a squad containing liter (B1). Proven non-vacuous by the ungated counterfactual (formation stripped ⇒ the buff appears), which is exactly the nearest-wrong model.

spec.kitLine: CA: Cooldown of Burst Skill ▼7.48 sec

Either partsDamagePct=48 is present or the line appears in `unmodeled`. Fails only on a silent drop.
advantageVs{element:'Electric'} present. Fails under a flat elementDamagePct, which would pay out against the Fire scope-lock boss.

A skill2 block whose trigger carries count===120 (ROUNDS, not seconds). Fails under an interval trigger, which decouples the channel from fire rate and reloads.

skill2-sourced damage also occurs at/after the first fullBurstStart. Fails if the stored charge releases on the accrual trigger with no FB dependency.

burstCdr seconds===20 present in the burst slot (structural).

fixtures: controlComp('rapi-red-hood', /*helm*/ false) — liter (B1) + crown (B2) + rapi-red-hood (B3), Fire boss. helm is dropped deliberately: she is a second Burst III and would contest the B3 rotation slot, making 'did RRH cast her own burst' non-deterministic for the 2808% stage-3 line. liter (B1) is retained on purpose — it is the squad fact that CANCELS Combat Assist, so this single fixture exercises the not-in-Combat-Assist half of skill1 plus the stage-3 burst branch, and proves the Combat-Assist half inert. The inactive (no-B1 / Combat Assist / stage-1) half is unreachable from controlComp, so it is covered by (a) a formation-stripped counterfactual run that proves the inertness assertions are non-vacuous and (b) structural assertions read off the override clone returned by a no-op withPatchedOverride. 5 hoisted runs: base, burst-nuke-zeroed, projectile-channel-zeroed, formation-ungated, 95.04%-zeroed.
gaps: burst — 'Projectile Attachment Damage ▲421.2% for 10 sec': no flavor-scoped StatKey (projectileAttachment/projectileExplosion exist only as damage-effect flavors, not as buffable stats); a 10s window cannot be baked into the stored-hit atkPct without crediting the entire fight. it.skip'd.

burst — "Skill 2's requirement for triggering attachable projectiles ▼60 for 10 sec": no primitive scales a trigger's `count` for a window; modeling it as a permanent 60 threshold would roughly double projectile procs. it.skip'd.

skill1 — 'Combat Assist: Changes to Burst Stage 1': no effect kind re-tiers a unit's burst stage; expressible only as the formation gate on the dependent blocks. Structurally asserted, behaviourally untestable in a hasB1 fixture.

skill2 — continuous 'Projectile Attachment Damage ▲150.72%' / 'Projectile Explosion Damage ▲100.6%': same missing-StatKey gap; asserted only as a magnitude floor (channel atkPct ≥ 88.11) because a baked encoding is legitimate for a continuous line and I cannot distinguish baked-vs-separate blind.

⚑ MG cadence (pullsPerSec / reloadFrames 171) is datamine-sourced and unreliable; it sets how often the 120-round threshold is crossed, so the projectile proc COUNT is measurement-gated even though the trigger shape is not. No assertion pins proc count.
⚑ Explosion core rate and crit eligibility are outside the kit text (the prose gives neither); not asserted here — measured-only.
skill2 — elemental advantage vs Electric is asserted structurally only; controlComp's boss is Fire and I have no blind-safe way to swap boss element in this fixture.
